assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances and assess for intermittent high-grade block or tachyarrhythmias.
The CPT code for the service is 93226.
The claim was denied under Reason Code PR-204.
